device.name: NSLS-II SST ADR cryostat (caproto EPICS IOC, read only)

facts.text: ADR is documented as a class to read temperatures from NIST's adr_gui.
ADR declares TEMP as an ai pvproperty documented as 'temperature in k'.
ADR declares TEMP_SP as an ai pvproperty with the initial value 0.050, documented as 'temperature setpoint'.
The TEMP_SP putter sends the command set_temp_sp_k with the written value.
ADR declares TEMP_SP_RB as an ai pvproperty documented as 'temperature setpoint readback'.
The update hook writes TEMP_SP_RB from the controller message key temp_sp_rb.
ADR declares TEMP_RMS_UK as an ai pvproperty documented as 'temperature rms stability in uk'.
The update hook writes TEMP_RMS_UK from the controller message key stddev.
ADR declares ALT_TEMP as an ai pvproperty documented as '2nd channel temperature'.
The update hook writes ALT_TEMP from the controller message key alt_temp.
ADR declares HEATER_OUT as an ai pvproperty documented as 'heater'.
The update hook writes HEATER_OUT from the controller message key heater.
ADR declares STATE as a string pvproperty documented as 'ADR Mode'.
For the controller message key state, the update hook writes STATE only when the value differs from the current STATE value.
ADR declares CYCLE_UID as a string pvproperty documented as 'Cycle UID'.
For the controller message key uid, the update hook writes CYCLE_UID only when the value differs from the current CYCLE_UID value.
ADR declares PAUSE as a writable pvproperty documented as 'Pause PID Loop'.
The PAUSE putter sends pausePID when the written value is 1 and resumePID otherwise.
ADR declares START_CYCLE as a writable pvproperty documented as 'Start Cryo Cycle'.
The START_CYCLE putter sends start_mag_cycle when the written value is truthy.
The update hook is a 0.1 s scan that receives one JSON message from the ZeroMQ SUB socket and dispatches temperature, alt_temp, state, heater, stddev, uid and temp_sp_rb.
The ADR constructor connects a ZeroMQ SUB socket to the configured address and sub_port and subscribes to every message.
command serializes method, params and kwargs as JSON, sends it on a ZeroMQ REQ socket to the configured control_port, closes the socket and does not read a reply.

safe_state.description: No change: the package only reads the IOC's PVs; it writes no PV and declares no stop, so the ADR controller, its PID loop, heater output and any magnet cycle stay as they are.
